purpose: Teach: 於け/探訪/無実/乞う/絶た/幾多/慶応/変調

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現場に於ける証拠の保全を、警察、徹底されますね
lines.en: The police will be thorough about preserving evidence at the scene, won't they?
lines.style: Measured, careful. Spoken as an observation, not a question—certainty wrapped in politeness. Slight pause before the final phrase, like he's testing the words' weight.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場周辺の探訪、つまり聞き込みもされますね
lines.en: The police will also be conducting interviews in and around the scene, won't they?
lines.style: Direct but collaborative. Professional tone, steady rhythm. Affirming what's already understood. No performance—just confirmation between people who know the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被疑者が無実を主張する局面を、警察、慎重に判断されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police will be careful to judge when the suspect claims innocence, won't they?
lines.style: Deliberate, almost analytical. Each clause lands with equal weight. Quiet gravity—he's naming something that matters. No rush.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ご遺族の協力を乞う声明も発表されますね
lines.en: The police will also be issuing a statement asking for the family's cooperation, won't they?
lines.style: Professional and steady. Matter-of-fact delivery. Acknowledging a necessary step. Warm undertone—this is difficult for the family, and he knows it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、連絡が絶たれた被害者の追跡を、警察、続けられますね
lines.en: The police will continue to track down the victim, whose contact has been lost, won't they?
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Slightly slower pace on 'contact has been lost'—he's naming the gap, the absence. No rush. This is the hard part.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、幾多の困難な事件を解決して来られましたね
lines.en: The police have solved many difficult cases over the years, haven't they?
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Slight warmth—acknowledging the track record without flattery. Professional respect. Brief pause after 'years,' like he's giving credit where it's due.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、慶応大学の専門家にも、警察、ご意見を仰がれますね
lines.en: The police will be consulting with experts at Keio University on this case, won't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, deferential. Speaking of specialists as a necessary resource. Even tone—he's stating what's logical, what has to happen next.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の体調変調を、医療と連携して確認されますね
lines.en: The police will be coordinating with medical professionals to assess changes in the victim's condition, won't they?
lines.style: Careful, precise. Clinical register but not cold—he understands the stakes. Even pacing. Slight warmth when naming the coordination between systems.
